annotation.title_clean: Proyecto de Ley "Por medio del cual se regula la inteligencia artificial en Colombia para garantizar su desarrollo ético y responsable y se dictan otras disposiciones" (Exposición de motivos y articulado)
annotation.title_en: Bill "Regulating artificial intelligence in Colombia to guarantee its ethical and responsible development and other provisions" (Explanatory memorandum and articles)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación; Ministerio de las TIC de Colombia (with congressional co-sponsors)
annotation.venue: Senado de la República de Colombia
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Colombian government bill, filed in the Senate on 7 May 2025, to regulate AI with a risk-based classification modelled on the EU AI Act. It sets up AI governance bodies, innovation and training provisions, labour transition measures, international cooperation and sanctions. Physical AI appears only in passing (robotic surgery, autonomous vehicles, industrial robots).
key_provisions_or_claims: Risk classification of AI systems, following the EU AI Act model
Creates a governance structure for AI, with procedures and sanctions to protect fundamental rights
Promotes the science, technology and innovation ecosystem, AI training and social appropriation
Includes labour transformation and innovation promotion measures
Existing AI systems must comply with the law once it takes effect (Art. 34)
